_README: Review every entry before running convert.
Set 'atlas_id' to the correct entity, or null to skip the label.
Only the RIGHT side was tracked; the left was not run (see the report's limits).

The common fibular nerve was attempted and is NOT shipped: it was detected on only 13 of 32 levels over 31 mm (y -328 .. -359), which is not unambiguous enough to carry the name 'common_fibular_n'. No label for it exists in this volume.
subject: ct_vhf_popliteal

entries.note: Right popliteal artery LUMEN, tracked through her full-resolution cryosections (0.33 mm) by scripts/cryo/vhf_popliteal_track.py from a landmark-rule seed (the deep member of the lumen pair behind the popliteal surface of her femur). Covers atlas y -307 to -386 mm, i.e. from just below the adductor hiatus (lower border of adductor magnus, y = -305) to ~11 mm past the knee joint line (y = -397); the division at the lower border of popliteus (y = -490) is NOT covered. Measured lumen diameter median 4.3 mm (p10 3.7, p90 5.3) against a textbook 5-8 mm: the tracked mask is the dark clotted lumen, not the wall, and a muscular artery contracts post mortem, so this under-measures the vessel. Verified on the montage and by the depth-order check (it is the most anterior of the three at every 10 mm band).

Right popliteal vein LUMEN, same run and same rules, as the superficial (posterior) member of the pair. Covers atlas y -305 to -360 mm; below that the lumen could not be separated from the fat of the fossa and the levels were dropped. Measured lumen diameter median 5.5 mm (p10 3.7, p90 6.2) against a textbook 7-11 mm: this is a cadaver and the vein is collapsed, which is reported as measured rather than forced up to the textbook figure. Lies between the artery and the tibial nerve at every band.

Tibial nerve in the popliteal fossa (side-agnostic id, RIGHT side only in this volume), tracked by fascicle texture in the same run. Covers atlas y -340 to -374 mm only (21 verified levels over 34 mm): this is a NEW segment, NOT a duplicate of the shipped sciatic track (vhf_nerves_cryo.nii.gz, which stops at y = -235). Median section diameter 5.6 mm. It is the most superficial of the three: median 19.9 mm posterior and 15.9 mm lateral to the artery, 15.4 mm posterior to the vein, at every level. The fossa levels above y = -340 are not shipped: the detector fired there on only 2 levels.
